defect.description: Input_args given as ordinary ffmpeg arguments in a string rather than a preset name (for example '-rtsp_transport tcp') are concatenated as a str onto the argument list: get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) + '-rtsp_transport tcp' raises TypeError (can only concatenate list to list), so audio detection fails to start; the fallbacks need get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) like the global args.

review_items: TypeError when input_args is a non-preset string (raw str concatenated onto list)
IndexError when no input has the audio role
Hardcoded detect_fps=1 injects -r 1 into audio-only streams
global_args not resolved as a preset name
No test for non-preset string input_args
votes.evidence_quote: parse_preset_input returns None, the or chain short-circuits on the truthy raw string, and get_ffmpeg_arg_list(global_args) + str raises TypeError: can only concatenate list to list.
votes.justification: Finding 1 names the defect directly. A non-preset string in input_args is concatenated raw onto a list in get_ffmpeg_command, which raises TypeError, and the fix it suggests is to wrap the fallbacks in get_ffmpeg_arg_list.
